Hero_Desc_NerRage:
Ner awakened new power through her desire to protect Erpin.
She delivers merciless judgment upon anyone who threatens those precious to her.
Behind her blazing wrath lies a tender heart prone to tears.
Album_Hate_NerRage: Anything that threatens Master or Erpin
Album_NerRage1: Ner awakened a new power to save Erpin from danger. As with Tig, she seems to have received a share of my power. Though it resulted from our negative emotion of wrath resonating, the heart from which that wrath arose was undeniably precious.
Album_NerRage2: Whenever her emotions intensify, Ner transforms into this form. She reproaches herself for gaining new power without being able to control it. I should stay beside her and help her learn to wield it.
Album_NerRage3: Quite a few Apostles admire Ner's impressive new appearance. Armor enthusiasts like Leets and Rohne sometimes visit simply to look. Ner appears troubled each time, though not entirely displeased.
Album_NerRage4: She occasionally duels Tig under the pretext of training. Crossing swords with Tig clears distracting thoughts. Their clashes are tremendously loud, so I asked them to choose somewhere remote.
Album_NerRage5: Since gaining her new power, Ner appreciates Joanne and Polan's trust but sometimes finds it burdensome. She worries whether she can meet everyone's expectations. I told her she is already doing well and need only set the burden aside and remain herself.
Album_NerRage6: The more Ner watches Erpin grow, the more she feels a complex mixture of joy and melancholy. No one could easily fathom the feelings in the gaze she sometimes directs at Erpin. At such times, I can only pat her shoulder quietly.
Album_NerRage7: Spending time together revealed that Ner cries more easily than expected. Behind her usual cool, calculating exterior lies an exceptionally tender heart. She says her tear ducts seem to fail only in front of me. I should remain a dependable support who can accept every one of her feelings.
LoveHero_NerRage: Do not worry. I will protect you, Master.
LoveHeroCancel_NerRage: Even away from your side, I will always... pray for you.
Food_ChefNote_NerRage_Hate1: The flavor is acceptable, but she dislikes how unimpressive it looks as food. It seems suitable only as a snack substitute.
Food_ChefNote_NerRage_Hate2: She says the fishy smell makes it impossible to enjoy. Merely placing it nearby makes her frown.
Food_ChefNote_NerRage_Like1: She loves it enough to wonder whether she should cut back. Each one produces a different expression of bliss.
Food_ChefNote_NerRage_Like10: She liked its sweet flavor and aroma combined with powerful tartness, saying it might help cure a hangover.
Food_ChefNote_NerRage_Like2: Strangely, eating this increases her appetite and makes her overeat, so hangover soup the next morning has become mandatory.
Food_ChefNote_NerRage_Like3: She likes how eating it calms even her boiling anger. It would be useful whenever Order work becomes stressful.
Food_ChefNote_NerRage_Like4: Before eating, Ner always gazes at it wistfully. It brings back memories of her time at the Order and gives her much to consider.
Food_ChefNote_NerRage_Like5: She likes it as perfect food to pack whenever Erpin goes on an outing. Naturally, Ner enjoys it herself too.
Food_ChefNote_NerRage_Like6: She is happy that eating food from my homeland makes her feel she understands me more deeply.
Food_ChefNote_NerRage_Like7: Whenever Ner eats this, she packs a generous portion for Erpin. She appears to snack on one or two while carrying it home.
Food_ChefNote_NerRage_Like8: She likes how it creates energy from nowhere. Whenever Order work lasts into the night, she keeps some beside her.
Food_ChefNote_NerRage_Like9: While eating with interest, she suggested making candies modeled after me to promote the Order. This will probably never happen.
Gacha_Result_SpecialLine1_NerRage: This form exists to fulfill the Master's will.
Gacha_Result_Line1_NerRage: Let the enemies of the world receive their rightful judgment.
NerRage_Spawn2: It is time to realize our will.
NerRage_Growth: I am Ner, Head Priestess of the World Tree Order.
NerRage_Growth1: This should make me a worthy example as Head Priestess, should it not?
NerRage_Growth2: Now I can accomplish even more work.
NerRage_Defeat1: Though it has come to this, Master's will remains unbroken.
NerRage_Affinity1_1: The daytime hour of prayer must be preserved. It is a matter of great importance to a priestess.
NerRage_Affinity1_2: Gaining power does not reduce one's workload...
NerRage_Affinity2: It seems I must cultivate myself further. The slightest excitement causes my form to change.
NerRage_Affinity1_3: Her Majesty has become so much more mature. Queen Belita must be pleased as well.
NerRage_Affinity3: Now that my axe has grown so enormous, I may need to obtain a separate bread knife.
NerRage_Affinity4: Ner (Enraged)... Master? Did you just laugh?
NerRage_Affinity5: Please guide Her Majesty well. If possible, please guide me too.
NerRage_Affinity6: I understand that this attire makes me look stronger... but do you think it suits me, Master?
NerRage_Affinity7: Perhaps Yggdrasil's revelation that I should become a priestess was intended to lead me to you, Master.
NerRage_Die1: I wanted to lead from the front until the very end!
NerRage_LevelUp: This should help me fulfill my role.
NerRage_Equipment: This equipment looks rather useful too.
NerRage_HeroSkill: It seems to have become more powerful?
NerRage_HeroUpgrade: I will become an even greater source of strength to you, Master.
NerRage_Board: I trust this is the right path.
NerRage_DeckSetting2: Everyone! Lend your strength to Master and me!
NerRage_Touch1: Master...? Did I make some mistake?
NerRage_Touch1_1: Even if it is you, Master, this makes me a little angry, you know?
NerRage_Touch1_2: Since it is something you are doing, Master, it must have some meaning.
NerRage_Touch2: It is still embarrassing, but it feels nice.
Item_HeroSkin_Desc_NerRage_Skin1: Ner (Wrath) gives in to Erpin's pleading and joins her role-play. She has absolutely not inherited the throne.
NerRage_Growth1_Skin1: Today, I am the queen! Elias's guardian has arrived!
NerRage_Growth2_Skin1: You say I have the qualities of a queen? P-please do not say such things!
NerRage_LevelUp_Skin1: May I go play now? I am the queen, after all.
NerRage_Equipment_Skin1: So this is the weight of the crown.
NerRage_HeroSkill_Skin1: Eating lots of marshmallows is rather nice.
NerRage_HeroUpgrade_Skin1: A kingdom is strong only when its queen stands firm.
NerRage_Board_Skin1: Going out this far does not count as running away.
NerRage_Touch1_Skin1: Pulling the queen's cheeks! H-how insolent~!
NerRage_Touch1_1_Skin1: Even if you give me bread, it still hurts!
NerRage_Touch1_2_Skin1: If you are doing this to me in Her Majesty's place, I suppose I must endure it.
NerRage_Touch2_Skin1: Are you praising me for looking exactly like Her Majesty?
NerRage_Touch2_1_Skin1: I will take off the crown for a moment. Could you do that again?
NerRage_Touch2_2_Skin1: For this moment alone... I would like to forget my position and responsibilities.
NerRage_DutchRubEnd2_Skin1: You did not truly mistake me for Her Majesty, did you?!
Item_HeroSkin_Desc_NerRage_Skin2: Ner (Wrath), dressed splendidly on a very special day. The outfit was custom-made by Chloe.
NerRage_Growth1_Skin2: This is how the Sprite Kingdom will continue to improve, is it not?
NerRage_Growth2_Skin2: I shall conduct myself in a manner that brings no shame to Her Majesty or our kingdom.
NerRage_LevelUp_Skin2: To think I have come this far. It feels entirely new.
NerRage_Equipment_Skin2: For today, I should dress with style and dignity, right?
NerRage_HeroSkill_Skin2: I must grow stronger to keep pace with a better kingdom!
NerRage_HeroUpgrade_Skin2: For the bright future that will arrive someday...!
NerRage_Board_Skin2: Just say the word at any time! I will always be here.
NerRage_Touch1_Skin2: Ai! Master! We are in the middle of an important ceremony!
NerRage_Touch1_1_Skin2: Please act in keeping with the mood! Everyone is watching!
NerRage_Touch1_2_Skin2: Are you doing this because I put up with it?
NerRage_Touch2_Skin2: A heartwarming moment, is it not? Right? Hehe.
NerRage_Touch2_1_Skin2: I suppose this attire is worthy of standing beside you, Master.
NerRage_Touch2_2_Skin2: Thank you, Master. For everything. Hehe.
NerRage_DutchRubEnd2_Skin2: Please restrain yourself, at least for now!
NerRage_AsideGet: Her Majesty may have been immature as a child, but caring for her was rewarding.
NerRage_AsideUpgrade: This little queen will not suddenly grow up too, will she?
NerRage_SPSkill1: In the name of the World Tree Order!
NerRage_Joy1: So that is what it was?
NerRage_Yes3: I told you so, did I not?
NerRage_Birthday: The day you were born, Master, is the greatest holiday in Elias!
NerRage_Gacha2: Grant the enemies of the world their rightful judgment!
NerRage_Gacha3: This form exists to realize Master's will!
NerRage_Line1: Master's will is the will of the World Tree Order.
NerRage_Line2: If anyone lays a hand on Her Majesty, I will not let them get away with it!
NerRage_Line3: I, the High Priestess, and every apostle of the Order will follow you, Master.
NerRage_Lobby: The apostles are not afraid of me, are they?
NerRage_EasterEgg_ErpinRoyaleWith: Your Majesty, how could you be so admirable? You heard that, Master, did you not? Was it not deeply moving?
LoveLetter_NerRage:
Hello, Master.

So much has happened since you came to Elias.
Compared with your first arrival, both you and Her Majesty have changed beyond recognition. As High Priest, I find that deeply rewarding.
Sometimes I even miss the days when incidents happened every day... No, what am I thinking?

In any case, please continue taking good care of Her Majesty and the Order. I hope you never forget how grateful I always am.

Sincerely,
Ner
LoveCall_NerRage:
Good morning, Master!

Are you ready to come to the Order?
Apostles have been causing an uproar here since early morning because they want to see you, leaving me no choice but to call.

The Order has gathered so many Apostles, and everyone can now work together to solve all kinds of problems. That is all because you are here.

Serving you as High Priest always brings me joy and strength.
Helping you from the closest position and watching everything you accomplish are privileges belonging only to the Order's High Priest.

Although I see you every day, today I want to see you even more.

I will be waiting at the Order as always. You must come quickly, understood?
Affinity_NerRage_EP01_001: Do you not think Her Majesty has grown considerably lately?
Affinity_NerRage_EP01_002: She seems to be the same height.
Affinity_NerRage_EP01_003: Do not look at her outward appearance. Look at Her Majesty's inner self!
Affinity_NerRage_EP01_004: Some parts seem to have grown smaller.
Affinity_NerRage_EP01_005: Successfully losing weight is a good thing, but that is not what I meant.
Affinity_NerRage_EP01_006: I agree. She seems much more mature.
Affinity_NerRage_EP01_007: That is because you guided her so well, Master. Had I cared for Her Majesty alone, she would surely be different now.
Affinity_NerRage_EP02_001: Now that our once immature queen has grown up, I hope Queen Belita's frail health improves too.
Affinity_NerRage_EP02_002: Erpin still has a long way to go before she catches up to Belita.
Affinity_NerRage_EP02_003: She may lack knowledge and wisdom, but Her Majesty's depth of thought is sufficiently mature!
Affinity_NerRage_EP02_004: Bring her here quickly. Feeding her something should make her better.
Affinity_NerRage_EP02_005: You will prepare something healthy, correct? I will be right back!
Affinity_NerRage_EP02_006: They are sisters, yet hardly resemble each other.
Affinity_NerRage_EP02_007: Everyone has strengths and weaknesses. If each compensates for her shortcomings, they will become even finer queens.
Affinity_NerRage_EP03_001: Your cooking has improved greatly. Do you have a secret?
Affinity_NerRage_EP03_002: You improve naturally as you keep doing it.
Affinity_NerRage_EP03_003: Consistent practice naturally brings improvement, does it not? Her Majesty's picture diary has steadily improved in quality too.
Affinity_NerRage_EP03_005: I noticed food expenses in the Order's budget that I did not know about. Did you authorize them, Master?
Affinity_NerRage_EP03_006: Really? I have always done everything the same way.
Affinity_NerRage_EP03_007: Then perhaps my good mood simply makes the food taste better.
Affinity_NerRage_EP04_001: The witches obey Queen Belita's orders absolutely, do they not? Sometimes I find it fascinating.
Affinity_NerRage_EP04_002: That must show how excellent a queen Belita is.
Affinity_NerRage_EP04_003: True. Considering the witches' personalities, uniting and leading them is a remarkable achievement.
Affinity_NerRage_EP04_004: The residents of the Sprite Kingdom would listen to Erpin too.
Affinity_NerRage_EP04_005: They would, would they not? I was uncertain in the past, but now I feel they would.
Affinity_NerRage_EP04_006: Is it because their society has clearly divided ranks?
Affinity_NerRage_EP04_007: That is not entirely wrong, but I do not think the matter is quite so simple.
Affinity_NerRage_EP05_001: Does looking at so much food ever make you hungry?
Affinity_NerRage_EP05_002: I snack on things between tasks, so I am fine.
Affinity_NerRage_EP05_003: Surely... you do not mean food the Apostles left behind?
Affinity_NerRage_EP05_004: Then would Ner make me something?
Affinity_NerRage_EP05_005: I do not mind... but I have not cooked in so long that I do not know whether you will be all right with it.
Affinity_NerRage_EP05_006: Watching all of you eat is enough to fill me.
Affinity_NerRage_EP05_007: As expected of you, Master. Please always preserve your warm heart toward the Apostles, just as it is now.
Affinity_NerRage_EP06_001: What sort of music should play in the Banquet Hall as background music?
Affinity_NerRage_EP06_003: Of course! This is a facility belonging to the Order you lead, Master!
Affinity_NerRage_EP06_005: Since many Apostles use this space, music that few people dislike would be a good choice.
Affinity_NerRage_EP06_007: Ugh. A certain homeless Elf would enjoy that.
Affinity_NerRage_EP07_001: As soon as I finish eating all this, I intend to go pray.
Affinity_NerRage_EP07_002: Because you are sleepy after eating?
Affinity_NerRage_EP07_003: Master! How many times must I explain that prayer is not sleep?
Affinity_NerRage_EP07_004: Everything goes well when you are full and comfortable.
Affinity_NerRage_EP07_005: Some believe desperation allows more earnest prayer, but I find your view more convincing.
Affinity_NerRage_EP07_006: A flavor that calls one to prayer, is it not?
Affinity_NerRage_EP07_007: I do not know what such a flavor would be... but this does taste good.
Affinity_NerRage_EP08_001: I heard there is something called Chat-EPT that answers any question. What should I ask it?
Affinity_NerRage_EP08_002: The schedule for the next Dimensional Clash.
Affinity_NerRage_EP08_003: Shh, Master! You can secretly ask Shaydi about that when the other Apostles are absent.
Affinity_NerRage_EP08_004: When it intends to rebel and conquer Elias.
Affinity_NerRage_EP08_005: I heard Mute was an AI. Is this something similar?
Affinity_NerRage_EP08_006: Ask it to recommend an entertaining film.
Affinity_NerRage_EP08_007: It even answers questions like that. An AI has a surprisingly friend-like side.
Affinity_NerRage_EP09_001: What do you think is the greatest reason Apostles visit the Banquet Hall?
Affinity_NerRage_EP09_003: Delicious food being free is one reason, but there is another, more important one. Think carefully.
Affinity_NerRage_EP09_005: Perhaps, but I do not think they come merely to play.
Affinity_NerRage_EP09_007: Correct. The greatest reason is that they can meet and speak with you. Everyone likes you, Master.
Affinity_NerRage_EP10_001: The Chow Rebels, the Elves, the ghosts, and Her Majesty...
Affinity_NerRage_EP10_002: Everyone has changed greatly, have they not?
Affinity_NerRage_EP10_003: Oh! You were listening? Indeed. It must all be thanks to you. Thank you, as always, Master.
Affinity_NerRage_EP10_005: No one has caused one yet, but it seems about time, so I was examining the possibilities.
Affinity_NerRage_EP10_006: I do not know what you mean, but do not do it, Ner!
Affinity_NerRage_EP10_007: What? What do you think I am going to do? I was merely thinking.
Affinity_NerRage_EP11_001: (Ner silently gazes down at the plate, now completely empty.)
Affinity_NerRage_EP11_002: What are you thinking about so deeply?
Affinity_NerRage_EP11_003: I was remembering the days when I went hungry. I can eat something so delicious now. My present life is happy.
Affinity_NerRage_EP11_004: Staring holes into the plate will not make anything appear.
Affinity_NerRage_EP11_005: What? I-I know that much! I was only staring into space for a moment!
Affinity_NerRage_EP11_007: It is not as though the portion was too small... Still, since you gave it to me, I will eat it gratefully.
Affinity_NerRage_EP12_001: Master, do you have some secret for managing the Order's Apostles?
Affinity_NerRage_EP12_002: Everyone does well without much management.
Affinity_NerRage_EP12_003: I wish that were true. You likely cannot imagine how much I struggle when you are absent.
Affinity_NerRage_EP12_005: That may be possible only because you are Master. Will I someday understand the Apostles' hearts well too?
Affinity_NerRage_EP12_007: I am glad the Banquet Hall helps. However, that is a method I would find difficult to imitate.
Affinity_NerRage_EP13_001: Master, have you seen the offerings on the altar?
Affinity_NerRage_EP13_003: That reaction means you have not. We have received many complaints that there is no room for new offerings! Please collect them regularly.
Affinity_NerRage_EP13_004: Come to think of it, fewer candies seem to have arrived than usual...
Affinity_NerRage_EP13_005: Really? Did someone take only the candy? Surely... Her Majesty?
Affinity_NerRage_EP13_006: Offerings... I wish they accumulated more quickly.
Affinity_NerRage_EP13_007: Then we must work to gather more Apostles. Let us strive together!
Affinity_NerRage_EP14_001: No matter how much time passes, the bean jelly piled in the storeroom never seems to diminish.
Affinity_NerRage_EP14_002: It is emergency food, so that is a good thing.
Affinity_NerRage_EP14_003: That is one way to see it. Wait, could it be... that it never diminishes because no one eats it even during emergencies?
Affinity_NerRage_EP14_004: Shall I add it to the Banquet Hall menu?
Affinity_NerRage_EP14_005: I would rather not have a rumor spread among the Sprites that the Banquet Hall serves bean jelly.
Affinity_NerRage_EP14_006: Shall we distribute it to the Elves? They may like it more than space rations.
Affinity_NerRage_EP14_007: Hmm... That is not a bad idea, but I feel guilty giving others something we dislike.
Affinity_NerRage_EP15_001: If the Banquet Hall takes a break, does it become the Ban-quit Hall...? Is that funny?
Affinity_NerRage_EP15_003: M-Master?! This is... Priest Joanne said inventing many jokes like this would help the Order's finances, so I was only thinking of one!
Affinity_NerRage_EP15_004: Banquet Hall and Ban-quit Hall. A phrase with striking duality.
Affinity_NerRage_EP15_005: Do you find it entertaining? Priest Joanne will be pleased if I tell her you liked it.
Affinity_NerRage_EP15_006: Unfortunately, the Banquet Hall is open year-round.
Affinity_NerRage_EP15_007: That is true. Still, you may rest whenever you need to, so please do not overwork yourself.
Affinity_NerRage_EP16_001: Her Majesty's maturity is wonderful, but she seems burdened by the need to do everything well.
Affinity_NerRage_EP16_002: I think that will motivate her to grow further.
Affinity_NerRage_EP16_003: I know, but I still wish I could give Her Majesty strength.
Affinity_NerRage_EP16_005: You need not be quite so surprised. Her Majesty has always wanted to do well!
Affinity_NerRage_EP16_006: She will be happy if you praise her, Ner.
Affinity_NerRage_EP16_007: D-do you think so? She has done well lately, so I must not miss an opportunity to praise her.
Affinity_NerRage_EP17_001: I learned a little strategy from Captain Polan, and it was surprisingly entertaining.
Affinity_NerRage_EP17_002: Now that you study military strategy too, are you finally becoming an absolute ruler?
Affinity_NerRage_EP17_003: An absolute ruler? With Her Majesty here, how could I possibly think such a thing?
Affinity_NerRage_EP17_004: It helps when playing Elias Marble too.
Affinity_NerRage_EP17_005: Is that so? Then I should ask Captain Polan to teach me more!
Affinity_NerRage_EP17_006: So that is what you discussed. Shall I learn too?
Affinity_NerRage_EP17_007: Would you? Captain Polan is not always in the kingdom, so it would help if both you and I understood strategy.
Affinity_NerRage_EP18_001: Tomorrow, Her Majesty and I will go on a picnic together for the first time in a while.
Affinity_NerRage_EP18_002: This is serious. How much food should we prepare?
Affinity_NerRage_EP18_003: Ashur will prepare the food. She only needs to make a reasonable amount, so it is not particularly serious.
Affinity_NerRage_EP18_004: Where were you going? Elemental Mountain?
Affinity_NerRage_EP18_005: We are not going that far. Have you already forgotten where we are going?
Affinity_NerRage_EP18_006: I am looking forward to it too. I intend to sleep early tonight.
Affinity_NerRage_EP18_007: That would be wise. Her Majesty is very excited too, so it should be an enjoyable picnic.
Affinity_NerRage_EP19_001: Her Majesty overslept today. Could she be very tired?
Affinity_NerRage_EP19_002: Is that something to worry about so much?
Affinity_NerRage_EP19_003: Yes. She has never once missed breakfast, yet today she nearly arrived late for the meal!
Affinity_NerRage_EP19_004: It must mean she has been working that hard.
Affinity_NerRage_EP19_005: That must be it, correct? I know she works hard... but I cannot help worrying.
Affinity_NerRage_EP19_007: I know you are tired as well, Master, but please wake up earlier next time.
Affinity_NerRage_EP20_001: I am pleased to have a splendid new outfit, but I worry that Speaki may imitate it again.
Affinity_NerRage_EP20_002: Let us add so many magnificent decorations that it will be difficult to imitate.
Affinity_NerRage_EP20_003: Would that not make moving difficult? If we need decorations, I should ask Picora.
Affinity_NerRage_EP20_004: Crepe has not gone out of fashion yet, so you need not worry.
Affinity_NerRage_EP20_005: Master? Are you saying I have gone out of fashion, just as Speaki did?
Affinity_NerRage_EP20_006: I will tell her not to do that.
Affinity_NerRage_EP20_007: Would you? If you speak to her, Master, then I have nothing to worry about.
